items.stem: A nurse is caring for a client with hyperthyroidism.
items.explanation: Monitor for tachycardia and heat intolerance is appropriate because it helps recognize increased metabolic rate.
items.jurisdictionNotes: US nursing education content aligned to common NCLEX-RN style priorities.
items.rationale: Endocrine nursing care depends on recognizing specific metabolic disturbances and implementing diagnosis-specific monitoring and teaching.
items.leadInQuestion: Which action or finding is most appropriate to address?

choices.text: monitor for tachycardia and heat intolerance
choices.label: A

choices.text: Encourage unrestricted fluid intake regardless of diagnosis
choices.label: B

choices.text: Assume all endocrine disorders require the same dietary plan
choices.label: C
